This is the same ESO error from before - the SecretStore is an ArgoCD PreSync hook that gets created and deleted on each failed sync attempt, causing the controller to log "not found" errors in a loop.

Has ArgoCD successfully synced since you applied the Terraform fix for the Keycloak secret? You can check with:

```bash
# Check if the SecretStore actually exists now
kubectl get secretstore -n crewai

# Check ArgoCD app sync status
kubectl get application crewai-dev -n argocd -o jsonpath='{.status.sync.status}'

# If still failing, force a sync
kubectl patch application crewai-dev -n argocd --type merge -p '{"operation":{"sync":{"revision":"HEAD"}}}'
```

If the sync is still failing, check what ArgoCD reports as the blocking resource:

```bash
kubectl get application crewai-dev -n argocd -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[*].message}'
```
